{"id":1903192318,"question_id":4176,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"5 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1769872215,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1903192318/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Minimum K to Reduce Array Within Limit","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ll = long long;\n    long long binarysearch(vector<int>&nums , int mid)\n    {\n        ll opr = 0;\n        for(int it : nums) opr += (it + mid - 1) / mid;\n        return opr;\n    }\n    \n    int minimumK(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int s = 1;\n        int e = *max_element(nums.begin() , nums.end());\n        long long ans = e;\n\n        while(s <= e){\n            int mid = s + (e-s)/2;\n            \n            if(binarysearch(nums , mid) <= (ll)(mid * mid))\n            {\n                ans = mid;\n                e = mid - 1;\n            }\n            else s = mid + 1;\n        }\n        \n    return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"minimum-k-to-reduce-array-within-limit","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1610}
